messages:
alex: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — recurring cache-eviction pattern. We need: (1) a terse 'first-5' triage checklist, (2) exact commands to run oncall, and (3) clarified escalation path with owners and SLAs. Can people volunteer to own parts?

sara: I can draft the triage checklist. Thinking minimal steps: 1) confirm incident type (cache vs infra), 2) gather metrics, 3) attempt quick mitigation, 4) escalate if > x errors or > y latency, 5) record and tag postmortem. Will add commands.

jordan: For commands — propose adding these to the runbook exactly as-is so oncall can copy/paste: ```# check recent eviction events
redwoodctl runtime kvcache inspect --since 30m --format short
# verify GPU memory and processes
kubectl top pods -n redwood | grep runtime
# tail runtime logs
kubectl logs -l app=redwood-runtime -c runtime --tail=200
# quick health check against model endpoint
curl -sS -X POST https://runtime.internal/api/v1/health -d '{"probe":"kv"}' | jq .status
```

mike: Escalation path proposal: oncall -> eng-sre (15m) -> eng-runtime (30m) -> eng-leads + customer-sre (60m). Contacts in runbook should be role-based and have primary/secondary. I can own the escalation contact table.

oncall-bot: Incident logged: ID INC-2026-1423 linked to this thread. Reminder set: runbook update due in 7 days.

sara: Adding an explicit rollback/fallback snippet so ops can degrade gracefully: ```# fallback to smaller model variant
redwoodctl route set --model model-small --traffic 100% --reason "eviction fallback"
# pinned quick-rollback
redwoodctl rollback --deployment $DEPLOYMENT_ID --to-revision $REV_ID
```

laura: Thanks — let's assign owners and timelines: sara -> update triage checklist + commands (due: 3 business days), jordan -> add command snippets into runbook + example outputs (due: 4 business days), mike -> build escalation contact table + confirm oncall rotations in playbook (due: 5 business days). I'll schedule a 30m sync for Thursday to review. :spiral_calendar:

alex: One more: include a short 'what to look for in telemetry' section: 95th token latency jump, kvcache hit-rate drop, and sudden spike in inference errors. Also add a one-line playbook note: when in doubt, scale read-only cache layer before evicting models.

sara: Will add the telemetry markers + example grafana queries. Example snippet for hit-rate: `sum(rate(kvcache_hits_total[5m]))/sum(rate(kvcache_requests_total[5m]))` and a pre-made panel link.

jordan: I'll include exact sample log lines to match for quick triage (eviction reason codes, OOM traces). Suggest we add a small troubleshooting section: if eviction reason == "kv_overbudget" -> bump shard limit, restart cache pod if persistent.

mike: I can draft the short-runbook PR and tag owners. I'll also add the SLA thresholds to the playbook (15m ack, 60m mitigation target).

laura: Summary of action items (copyable):
- sara: triage checklist + commands (due in 3bd)
- jordan: runbook command snippets + sample log matches (due in 4bd)
- mike: escalation table + SLA entries + rotation checks (due in 5bd)
- laura: schedule review + merge rules for small emergency PRs (due before review)
Please reply here to ack ownership. :white_check_mark:
